name: -d
--defaults
options.description: Specify a set of default option settings

options.name: --bash-completion
options.description: Generate a bash completion script

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Give verbose debugging output

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress warning messages

options.name: --fail-if-warnings
options.description: Exit with error status if there are any warnings

options.name: --log
options.description: Write log messages in machine-readable JSON format to FILE

options.name: --list-input-formats
options.description: List supported input formats, one per line

options.name: --list-output-formats
options.description: List supported output formats, one per line

options.name: --list-extensions
options.description: List supported extensions for FORMAT, one per line, preceded by a + or -  indicating whether it is enabled by default in FORMAT

options.name: --list-highlight-languages
options.description: List supported languages for syntax highlighting, one per line

options.name: --list-highlight-styles
options.description: List supported styles for syntax highlighting, one per line

name: -v
--version
options.description: Print version

name: -h
--help
options.description: Show usage message

options.name: --shift-heading-level-by
options.description: Shift heading levels by a positive or negative integer

options.name: --indented-code-classes
options.description: Specify classes to use for indented code blocks–for example, perl,numberLines or haskell. Multiple classes may be separated by spaces or commas

options.name: --default-image-extension
options.description: Specify a default extension to use when image paths/URLs have no extension.

options.name: --file-scope
options.description: Parse each file individually before combining for multifile documents.

name: -F
--filter
options.description: Specify an executable to be used as a filter transforming the pandoc AST after the input is parsed and before the output is written

name: -L
--lua-filter
options.description: Transform the document in a similar fashion as JSON filters, but use pandoc’s built-in Lua filtering system

name: -M
--metadata
options.description: Set the metadata field KEY to the value VAL

options.name: --metadata-file
options.description: Read metadata from the supplied YAML (or JSON) file

name: -p
--preserve-tabs
options.description: Preserve tabs instead of converting them to spaces

options.name: --tab-stop
options.description: Specify the number of spaces per tab

options.name: --track-changes
options.description: Specifies what to do with insertions, deletions, and comments produced by the MS Word `Track Changes` feature

suggestions.name: accept
suggestions.description: Processes all the insertions and deletions and ignores comments

suggestions.name: reject
suggestions.description: Ignores all the insertions and deletions and ignores comments

suggestions.name: all
suggestions.description: Includes all insertions, deletions, and comments, wrapped in spans with insertion, deletion, comment-start, and comment-end classes, respectively

options.name: --extract-media
options.description: Extract images and other media contained in or linked from the source document to the path DIR, creating it if necessary, and adjust the images references in th…

options.name: --abbreviations
options.description: Specifies a custom abbreviations file, with abbreviations one to a line.

name: -s
--standalone
options.description: Produce output with an appropriate header and footer (e.g. a standalone HTML, LaTeX, TEI, or RTF file, not a fragment).

options.name: --template
options.description: Use the specified file as a custom template for the generated document

name: -V
--variable
options.description: Set the template variable KEY to the value VAL when rendering the document in standalone mode. If no VAL is specified, the key will be given the value true

name: -D
--print-default-template
options.description: Print the system default template for an output FORMAT. Templates in the user data directory are ignored

options.name: --print-default-data-file
options.description: Print a system default data file. Files in the user data directory are ignored

options.name: --eol
options.description: Manually specify line endings: crlf (Windows), lf (macOS/Linux/UNIX), or native (line endings appropriate to the OS on which pandoc is being run).

suggestions.name: native
suggestions.description: Line endings appropriate to the OS on which Pandoc is being run

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Specify the default dpi (dots per inch) value for conversion from pixels to inch/centimeters and vice versa

options.name: --wrap
options.description: Determine how text is wrapped in the output (the source code, not the rendered version)

suggestions.name: auto
suggestions.description: Attempts to wrap lines to the column width specified by --columns (default 72)

suggestions.name: none
suggestions.description: Will not wrap lines at all

suggestions.name: preserve
suggestions.description: Attempts to preserve the wrapping from the source document

options.name: --columns
options.description: Specify length of lines in characters. This affects text wrapping in the generated source code

name: --toc
--table-of-contents
options.description: Include an automatically generated table of contents (or, in the case of latex, context, docx, odt, opendocument, rst, or ms, an instruction to create one) in t…

options.name: --toc-depth
options.description: Specify the number of section levels to include in the table of contents

options.name: --strip-comments
options.description: Strip out HTML comments in the Markdown or Textile source, rather than passing them on to Markdown, Textile or HTML output as raw HTML.

options.name: --no-highlight
options.description: Disables syntax highlighting for code blocks and inlines, even when a language attribute is given

options.name: --highlight-style
options.description: Specifies the coloring style to be used in highlighted source code

options.name: --print-highlight-style
options.description: Prints a JSON version of a highlighting style, which can be modified, saved with a .theme extension, and used with --highlight-style

options.name: --syntax-definition
options.description: Instructs pandoc to load a KDE XML syntax definition file, which will be used for syntax highlighting of appropriately marked code blocks

name: -H
--include-in-header
options.description: Include contents of FILE, verbatim, at the end of the header

name: -B
--include-before-body
options.description: Include contents of FILE, verbatim, at the beginning of the document body

name: -A
--include-after-body
options.description: Include contents of FILE, verbatim, at the end of the document body

options.name: --resource-path
options.description: List of paths to search for images and other resources. If --resource-path is not specified, the default resource path is the working directory

args.name: search path
args.description: The paths should be separated by : on Linux, UNIX, and macOS systems, and by ; on Windows

options.name: --request-header
options.description: Set the request header NAME to the value VAL when making HTTP requests.

options.name: --no-check-certificate
options.description: Disable the certificate verification to allow access to unsecure HTTP resources

options.name: --self-contained
options.description: Produce a standalone HTML file with no external dependencies, using data: URIs to incorporate the contents of linked scripts, stylesheets, images, and videos

options.name: --html-q-tags
options.description: Use <q> tags for quotes in HTML. This option only has an effect if the smart extension is enabled

options.name: --ascii
options.description: Use only ASCII characters in output. Currently supported for XML, HTML formats, CommonMark, gfm, Markdown, roff ms , and to a limited degree LaTeX, roff man out…

options.name: --reference-links
options.description: Use reference-style links, rather than inline links, in writing Markdown or reStructuredText

options.name: --reference-location
options.description: Specify whether footnotes (and references, if reference-links is set) are placed at the end of the current (top-level) block, the current section, or the docume…

options.name: --markdown-headings
options.description: Specify whether to use ATX-style (#-prefixed) or Setext-style (underlined) headings for level 1 and 2 headings in Markdown output

options.name: --atx-headers
options.description: Deprecated synonym for --markdown-headings=atx

options.name: --top-level-division
options.description: Treat top-level headings as the given division type in LaTeX, ConTeXt, DocBook, and TEI output

name: -N
--number-sections
options.description: Number section headings in LaTeX, ConTeXt, HTML, Docx, ms, or EPUB output. By default, sections are not numbered

options.name: --number-offset
options.description: Offset for section headings in HTML output (ignored in other output formats)

args.name: number
args.description: The first number is added to the section number for top-level headings, the second for second-level headings, and so on

options.name: --listings
options.description: Use the listings package for LaTeX code blocks. The package does not support multi-byte encoding for source code.

name: -i
--incremental
options.description: Make list items in slide shows display incrementally

options.name: --slide-level
options.description: Specifies that headings with the specified level create slides (for beamer, s5, slidy, slideous, dzslides).

options.name: --section-divs
options.description: Wrap sections in <section> tags (or <div> tags for html4), and attach identifiers to the enclosing <section> (or <div>) rather than the heading itself

options.name: --email-obfuscation
options.description: Specify a method for obfuscating mailto: links in HTML documents references . The default is none

suggestions.name: none
suggestions.description: Leaves mailto: links as they are

suggestions.name: references
suggestions.description: Obfuscates mailto: links by printing their letters as decimal or hexadecimal character references

options.name: --id-prefix
options.description: Specify a prefix to be added to all identifiers and internal links in HTML and DocBook output, and to footnote numbers in Markdown and Haddock output

name: -T
--title-prefix
options.description: Specify STRING as a prefix at the beginning of the title that appears in the HTML header (but not in the title as it appears at the beginning of the HTML body)

name: -c
--css
options.description: Link to a CSS style sheet. This option can be used repeatedly to include multiple files. They will be included in the order specified

options.name: --reference-doc
options.description: Use the specified file as a style reference in producing a docx or ODT file

options.name: --epub-cover-image
options.description: Use the specified image as the EPUB cover. It is recommended that the image be less than 1000px in width and height.

options.name: --epub-metadata
options.description: Look in the specified XML file for metadata for the EPUB. The file should contain a series of Dublin Core elements

options.name: --epub-embed-font
options.description: Embed the specified font in the EPUB. This option can be repeated to embed multiple fonts. Wildcards can also be used

options.name: --pdf-engine
options.description: Use the specified engine when producing PDF output

options.name: --pdf-engine-opt
options.description: Use the given string as a command-line argument to the pdf-engine

name: -C
--citeproc
options.description: Process the citations in the file, replacing them with rendered citations and adding a bibliography.

options.name: --bibliography
options.description: Set the bibliography field in the document’s metadata to FILE, overriding any value set in the metadata.

options.name: --csl
options.description: Set the csl field in the document’s metadata to FILE, overriding any value set in the metadata.

options.name: --citation-abbreviations
options.description: Set the citation-abbreviations field in the document’s metadata to FILE, overriding any value set in the metadata.

options.name: --natbib
options.description: Use natbib for citations in LaTeX output. It is intended for use in producing a LaTeX file that can be processed with bibtex

options.name: --biblatex
options.description: Use biblatex for citations in LaTeX output. It is intended for use in producing a LaTeX file that can be processed with bibtex or biber

options.name: --mathjax
options.description: Use MathJax to display embedded TeX math in HTML output.

options.name: --mathml
options.description: Convert TeX math to MathML (in epub3, docbook4, docbook5, jats, html4 and html5). This is the default in odt output.

options.name: --webtex
options.description: Convert TeX formulas to tags that link to an external script that converts formulas to images.

options.name: --katex
options.description: Use KaTeX to display embedded TeX math in HTML output. The URL is the base URL for the KaTeX library.

options.name: --gladtex
options.description: Enclose TeX math in <eq> tags in HTML output.

options.name: --dump-args
options.description: Print information about command-line arguments to stdout, then exit. This option is intended primarily for use in wrapper scripts

options.name: --ignore-args
options.description: Ignore command-line arguments (for use in wrapper scripts). Regular pandoc options are not ignored
